assets.warrior:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D game character modular outfit source, NOT a concept presentation. Image 1 is the APPROVED ART AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE.
Create exactly TWO full-body images of The WARRIOR, second character in the reference: broad muscular shoulders, swept dark brown hair, short beard, weathered warm face. LEFT starting outfit: an ivory rolled-sleeve linen shirt, plain dark brown trousers, simple cloth sash, BARE hands and BARE feet. RIGHT equipment outfit: the same steel breastplate and articulated shoulders, dark moss mantle, leather gloves and boots from the reference. NO sword in either figure.
The two figures must have IDENTICAL anatomy, proportions, facing, head position, foot positions, hand positions and pose. They are two clothing layers for the SAME paper-doll character. Match the reference's beautiful hand-painted 2D game illustration, smooth clean contours, expressive face, broad material shading, restrained texture. NO pixel art or 3D rendering.
Composition: landscape canvas, exactly two equal cells in a single horizontal row; starting outfit in left cell, equipment outfit in right cell. Both bodies same height, head tops aligned, feet aligned. Entire figure including hair, cloak and toes inside its own cell with at least 8% clear padding. Neutral ready stance facing three-quarter RIGHT; feet planted, visible arms held slightly away from the body, elbows bent gently and hands approximately at waist height. No dramatic action. Do not mirror. Keep poses precisely matched. Every garment and body part has a clear visible boundary.
Illumination from upper left; matching palette to the reference (ivory, moss, muted blue, weathered leather and steel). Genuine fully transparent background everywhere outside the two figures. No floor, ground shadow, backdrop, text, headings, labels, swatches, weapons, helmets, scenery, frames or extra figures. This image will be divided exactly in half for runtime outfit compositing; placement consistency matters as much as quality.

assets.weapons: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent production equipment atlas matching the hand-painted 2D fantasy brushwork and material rendering in the reference image. Exactly THREE equal-width cells in one horizontal row: left a complete medieval steel longsword with dark leather grip and simple brass crossguard, middle a complete gnarled wood wizard staff topped with a small blue crystal in a brass cradle, right a complete elegant yew recurve bow with a clearly visible thin taut bowstring. Each object upright vertical, fully in frame, isolated, no characters or hands. All three have their top and bottom aligned with generous 12% padding. Full object visible. Clean realistic illustrated shapes, dark contours, upper-left light, textured wood/leather/brushed steel. TRUE transparent background, no scenery, no shadow, no text, no glow halo, no labels. Wide landscape atlas. Reference is STYLE only.
assets.headgear: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent production headgear atlas matching the hand-painted 2D fantasy brushwork and materials in the reference. Exactly FOUR equal-width cells in one horizontal row. Left: open-face medieval linen coif, an empty hollow hood with no face. Second: simple leather forehead band with a small brass center buckle and short cloth tie at left. Third: elegant narrow bronze circlet with a tiny green jewel. Fourth: ancient irregular gold crown with five low angular points and a small warm orange gem. All viewed three-quarter facing RIGHT to fit the forehead of the reference characters. No heads, faces, necks, hair, people, mannequin or body. Each headpiece fills its own cell at the same head width, centered with generous transparent space. Clean silhouette, readable dark contour, soft painted highlights. TRUE transparent background, no scenery, no shadow, no text, no labels. Wide landscape atlas. Reference is STYLE only.
